_note: v2 hooks for l'Allée des Ingénieurs (ST_ingenieurs, S10_university), an autumn engineering avenue on the campus with orange trees, red-brick workshops and the blue gear sculptures seen on the Campus map; the make-build-create street (ST_making seg010-013). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; beret color = verb group (all RED here: regular -er).

fr_faconner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe FASHIONS a gray felt hat with his hands on the wooden hat block: FASHION-AY! (fah-soh-NAY).
fr_faconner_verb.why: FASHION → façonner = to shape, to work (Le potier façonne un vase). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (fa-so-NAY -> fah-soh-NAY).

fr_reinventer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe RE-INVENTS the top hat: he holds it up with its own little propeller spinning on top (ray-an-vahn-TAY).
fr_reinventer_verb.why: RE-INVENT → réinventer = to reinvent (Le chef réinvente les plats traditionnels). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_devaster_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe clutches his face before a VAST heap of toppled hatboxes – his whole DAY, VAST ruins: DAY-VAST-AY! (day-vahs-TAY).
fr_devaster_verb.why: DAY + VAST → dévaster = to devastate (L'ouragan a dévasté l'île). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_assembler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe kneels and ASSEMBLES a metal stool from its parts with a screwdriver (ah-sahn-BLAY).
fr_assembler_verb.why: ASSEMBLE → assembler = to assemble, to put together. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_impatienter_verb.hook: In front of the tall mirror Monsieur Verbe crosses his arms and taps his foot – IMPATIENT with himself: s'IMPATIENT-AY! (an-pah-syahn-TAY).
fr_impatienter_verb.why: IMPATIENT → s'impatienter = to get impatient (Le public s'impatiente). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (sahn-pah-syahn-TAY -> an-pah-syahn-TAY).

fr_paver_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe kneels and PAVES the street, tapping each new cobblestone in with his mallet (pah-VAY).
fr_paver_verb.why: PAVE → paver = to pave, to cobble. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (pa-VAY -> pah-VAY).

fr_instaurer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe throws open the awning of a brand-new kiosk – he sets up a new IN-STORE: IN-STORE-AY! (an-sto-RAY).
fr_instaurer_verb.why: IN + STORE → instaurer = to set up, to establish (Le professeur instaure de nouvelles règles). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_structurer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe bolts blue steel beams together into a tall STRUCTURE (strewk-tew-RAY).
fr_structurer_verb.why: STRUCTURE → structurer = to structure. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (struk-tu-RAY -> strewk-tew-RAY).

fr_approvisionner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pushes a cart loaded with crates of PROVISIONS – apples, bread and vegetables – to supply the street (a-pro-vee-zyo-NAY).
fr_approvisionner_verb.why: A + PROVISION → approvisionner = to supply, to stock up. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_generer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe cranks the brass dynamo GENERATOR and the bulb on top lights up (zhay-nay-RAY).
fr_generer_verb.why: GENERATE → générer = to generate (je génère: è before a silent ending). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_axer_verb.hook: Up the ladder Monsieur Verbe turns the weathervane arrow round on its AXIS until it points the right way (ahk-SAY).
fr_axer_verb.why: AXIS → axer = to center on, to orient (Il axe son exposé sur l'écologie). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_fuser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lights the FUSE of his party popper – confetti and his laughter burst out together: FUSE-AY! (few-ZAY).
fr_fuser_verb.why: FUSE → fuser = to burst out, ring out (Les rires fusent dans la salle). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_synthetiser_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe plays the little SYNTHESIZER keyboard on the quay (san-tay-tee-ZAY).
fr_synthetiser_verb.why: SYNTHESIZE → synthétiser = to synthesize. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_exporter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lifts a crate onto the barge to EXPORT it down the canal (ehk-spor-TAY).
fr_exporter_verb.why: EXPORT → exporter = to export. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ex-por-TAY -> ehk-spor-TAY).

fr_styliser_verb.hook: At the easel Monsieur Verbe draws a STYLISH, STYLIZED sun of simple triangles (stee-lee-ZAY).
fr_styliser_verb.why: STYLIZE → styliser = to stylize. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_superposer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe strikes a SUPER POSE holding a red and a blue glass pane one over the other – they make purple: SUPER-POSE-AY! (sew-pehr-poh-ZAY).
fr_superposer_verb.why: SUPER + POSE → superposer = to superimpose, to lay one over another. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (su-pair-po-ZAY -> sew-pehr-poh-ZAY).

fr_roser_verb.hook: The cold turns Monsieur Verbe's cheeks ROSY as he sniffs a pink ROSE (roh-ZAY).
fr_roser_verb.why: ROSE / ROSY → roser = to turn pink (Le froid rose les joues des enfants). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ro-ZAY -> roh-ZAY).

fr_sublimer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe holds a plain LIME up to the colored window light and it glows SUBLIME: SUB-LIME-AY! (sew-blee-MAY).
fr_sublimer_verb.why: SUBLIME → sublimer = to make sublime, to enhance. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (su-blee-MAY -> sew-blee-MAY).
